chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his uncle Yaʿqūb al-Aḥmar, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about a man who had relations with his wife, then she menstruated before performing ghusl. He said: She makes it one ghusl.

key_terms.تَغْتَسِلَ: to perform ghusl, the ritual bath
key_terms.وَاحِدًا: a single one; one combined ghusl

ai.seo_question: If a woman becomes junub and then menstruates before ghusl, does she perform one ghusl or two?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who becomes junub through marital relations and then begins menstruation before performing ghusl. The Imam عليه السلام states that one ghusl suffices, indicating that the two causes are combined into a single ritual bath.
